Item Class: Tablet
Rarity: Magic
Plundering Expedition Precursor Tablet of Verisium
--------
Item Level: 77
--------
{ Implicit Modifier }
17(12-18) Maps in Range contain Expedition Encounters (implicit)
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Plundering" }
3(3-7)% increased Quantity of Items found in your Maps
{ Suffix Modifier "of Verisium" }
7(5-10)% increased quantity of Artifacts dropped by Monsters in your Maps
--------
Can be used in a completed Tower on your Atlas to influence surrounding Maps. Tablets are consumed once placed into a Tower.
